examples/v4/backend/src/routes.rs wires /health, /api/conversations, /api/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages, /api/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages/stream, CORS, and TraceLayer.

examples/v4/backend/src/lib.rs covers health, validation, persistence, repository, provider, streaming, title provenance, config, and decoder behavior in tests.

examples/v4/frontend/lib/api.ts references only NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL for browser API calls and contains no OpenRouter credential handling.
examples/v4/backend/src/lib.rs uses MockProvider, FailingStreamProvider, and EmptyStreamProvider for provider behavior tests without network calls.

examples/v4/frontend/components/ChatApp.tsx renders sidebar, transcript, composer, loading/error states, mobile sidebar controls, and assistant markdown via ReactMarkdown with remark-gfm.
examples/v4/frontend/components/ChatApp.tsx uses TanStack Query for conversation and message reads plus cache reconciliation.

examples/v4/frontend/lib/api.test.ts verifies blank title payload preservation.
examples/v4/backend/src/lib.rs verifies structured validation errors.

requirement_coverage_summary.requirement: Streaming setup failure, empty stream, truncated stream, split UTF-8, done-event handling, and final assistant persistence behavior match the plan.
evidence: examples/v4/backend/src/routes.rs acquires the provider stream before persisting the user turn, emits user/chunk/error/assistant/done NDJSON events, and persists assistant output only after non-empty successful stream content.
examples/v4/backend/src/openrouter.rs decodes OpenRouter SSE lines, buffers split UTF-8 across chunks, and rejects streams that end before data: [DONE].
examples/v4/frontend/lib/api.ts throws when an NDJSON stream closes before a done event.
examples/v4/backend/src/lib.rs tests setup failure persistence behavior, empty stream persistence behavior, and mocked stream assistant persistence.
examples/v4/backend/src/openrouter.rs tests missing [DONE] rejection and split UTF-8 decoding.
examples/v4/frontend/lib/api.test.ts tests truncated stream rejection and done-event completion.

requirement_coverage_summary.requirement: Frontend stream recovery behavior remains correct, including post-success refresh failure and a following in-flight send.
evidence: examples/v4/frontend/components/ChatApp.tsx records delivered user/assistant messages during stream callbacks.
examples/v4/frontend/components/ChatApp.tsx writes delivered messages into the ["messages", conversationId] query cache if post-send refresh fails, then clears pendingTurn.
examples/v4/frontend/components/ChatApp.tsx clears failed partial stream state, preserves the original send/stream error, and suppresses secondary recovery refetch errors.
examples/v4/frontend/components/ChatApp.test.tsx verifies delivered output remains visible when post-send refresh fails and remains visible during a following in-flight send.
examples/v4/frontend/components/ChatApp.test.tsx verifies mid-stream failure cleanup, pre-stream failure reload, failed recovery refetch behavior, and in-flight conversation switching prevention.

requirement_coverage_summary.requirement: Conversation switching during an in-flight stream is prevented and new-conversation post-stream message visibility is verified.

no_findings_rationale: No actionable spec deviations were found for examples/v4 PR #1 at head a53f3eb375823bd932e693cb162f9cbb677fc7f5. The approved plans, phase handoffs, and task decomposition define a local ChatGPT-style application with a Rust 2024 Axum SQLite/OpenRouter backend and a Next.js frontend. The delivered source implements that scope, documentation and environment defaults match implemented local-only and cwd-sensitive behavior, tests cover the backend, frontend, stream, cache recovery, title, and Playwright behaviors they claim to cover, and the requested latest CodeDungeon QA logs record the required backend and frontend verification commands passing. The latest delta specifically reconciles delivered stream messages into the query cache when the post-send refresh fails and adds focused component coverage proving those messages remain visible during a following in-flight send.
